set.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... passes with a build-retry test that finds the inspect-the-working-tree rule, the findings quoted verbatim in the prompt, rhiza run status --json, address every finding as written, the same `Leaf:` trailer fix commit and never rewrite history, and asserts the text stays under a third of the TopicCap and repeats none of the builder topic's shared blocks.
set.statement: `rhiza guide build-retry` tells a builder on a later attempt only what a retry adds: inspect the working tree and the earlier attempts' commits for their partial work, read the previous attempt's findings (quoted verbatim in the prompt when there, else `rhiza run status --json`), address every finding exactly as written, and add one fix commit with the same Leaf: trailer, never rewriting history.
